description_en: Submits a data backup task by calling the PutStartBackup operation
description_zh: 通过调用PutStartBackup接口提交数据备份任务
name: PutStartBackup

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the DRDS instance
parameters.name: drds_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The backup mode. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/108631.html. Valid values:

phy: fast backup
logic: consistent backup
parameters.help_zh:
备份模式，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/108631.html，取值范围如下：
phy：快速备份
logic：一致性备份
parameters.name: backup_mode

parameters.help_en:
The backup level. Valid values:  
instance: instance-level backup    
db: database-level backup
parameters.help_zh:
备份等级，取值范围如下：  
instance：实例级    
db：数据库级
parameters.name: backup_level

parameters.help_en: The list of databases to back up if you perform a database-level backup. Separate multiple database names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 如果是数据库级备份，需要指定需要备份的数据库列表，多个数据库间用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: backup_db_names

Result.description_en: The description of the request result

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the API request is successful
